subject: maths
question: A vendor bought a book marked at ₹850 at successive discounts of 20% and 10%, respectively. He spent ₹55 on transport and sold the book for ₹980. What will be his profit percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places)?
solution:
**Given:**

MP = ₹850 Discounts: 20%, 10% Transport cost = ₹55 SP = ₹980

**Formula used:**

Price after discount = Price - (Discount% * Price)

Total cost = Purchase price + Transport

Profit = SP - Total cost

Profit% = (Profit / Total cost) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ After 1st discount: 850 - (20% of 850) = 850 - (0.20 × 850) = ₹680

⇒ After 2nd discount: 680 - (10% of 680) = 680 - (0.10 × 680) = ₹612

⇒ Total cost = 612 + 55 = ₹667

⇒ Profit = 980 - 667 = ₹313

⇒ Profit% = (313 / 667) × 100 ≈ 46.93%

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
